kinds.name: Contra
kinds.about: Shares chosen against the market's current view; at least 65% in shares.

kinds.name: Dividend yield
kinds.about: Mostly shares that pay high dividends; at least 65% in shares.

kinds.name: ELSS (tax saver)
kinds.about: At least 80% in shares, locked in for 3 years; eligible for tax deduction.

kinds.name: Flexi cap
kinds.about: At least 65% in shares, of any size, in any mix.

kinds.name: Focused
kinds.about: At most 30 companies, at least 65% in shares.

kinds.name: Large and mid cap
kinds.about: At least 35% each in large and mid-sized companies.

kinds.name: Large cap
kinds.about: At least 80% in the 100 largest listed companies.

kinds.name: Mid cap
kinds.about: At least 65% in companies ranked 101st to 250th by size.

kinds.name: Multi cap
kinds.about: At least 25% each in large, mid-sized and small companies.

kinds.name: Sectoral
kinds.about: At least 80% in one sector, such as banks or technology.

kinds.name: Small cap
kinds.about: At least 65% in companies ranked 251st and below by size.

kinds.name: Thematic
kinds.about: At least 80% in one theme across sectors, such as consumption.

kinds.name: Value
kinds.about: Shares chosen for a low price against their value; at least 65% in shares.

kinds.name: Aggressive hybrid
kinds.about: 65% to 80% in shares, the rest in bonds.

kinds.name: Arbitrage
kinds.about: Buys and sells the same shares in different markets for the price gap.

kinds.name: Balanced advantage (dynamic asset allocation)
kinds.about: Moves between shares and bonds as the fund's model directs.

kinds.name: Balanced hybrid
kinds.about: 40% to 60% in shares and 40% to 60% in bonds.

kinds.name: Conservative hybrid
kinds.about: 75% to 90% in bonds, 10% to 25% in shares.

kinds.name: Equity savings
kinds.about: Shares, arbitrage and bonds together, at least 65% in shares with hedges.

kinds.name: Multi asset allocation
kinds.about: At least 10% each in three asset classes, such as shares, bonds and gold.

kinds.name: Banking and PSU
kinds.about: At least 80% in bonds of banks, public sector firms and public finance bodies.

kinds.name: Corporate bond
kinds.about: At least 80% in the highest-rated company bonds.

kinds.name: Credit risk
kinds.about: At least 65% in company bonds rated below the highest grades.

kinds.name: Dynamic bond (earlier AMFI heading)
kinds.about: Bonds of any maturity, changed as rates move, under a heading AMFI has since renamed.

kinds.name: Dynamic term
kinds.about: Bonds of any maturity, changed as rates move.

kinds.name: Fixed term plans
kinds.about: Closed-end plans holding bonds that mature with the plan.

kinds.name: Floating interest rates
kinds.about: At least 65% in bonds whose interest resets with market rates.

kinds.name: Gilt
kinds.about: At least 80% in government bonds, of any maturity.

kinds.name: Gilt, 10-year constant maturity
kinds.about: At least 80% in government bonds, averaging 10 years to maturity.

kinds.name: Liquid
kinds.about: Debt and money-market papers maturing within 91 days.

kinds.name: Long term
kinds.about: Bonds held for an average of more than 7 years.

kinds.name: Low duration (earlier AMFI heading)
kinds.about: Bonds held for an average of 6 to 12 months, under a heading AMFI has since renamed.

kinds.name: Medium duration (earlier AMFI heading)
kinds.about: Bonds held for an average of 3 to 4 years, under a heading AMFI has since renamed.

kinds.name: Medium term
kinds.about: Bonds held for an average of about 3 to 4 years.

kinds.name: Medium to long duration (earlier AMFI heading)
kinds.about: Bonds held for an average of 4 to 7 years, under a heading AMFI has since renamed.

kinds.name: Medium to long term
kinds.about: Bonds held for an average of about 4 to 7 years.

kinds.name: Money market
kinds.about: Money-market papers maturing within a year.

kinds.name: Overnight
kinds.about: Bonds and loans that mature the next day.

kinds.name: Short duration (earlier AMFI heading)
kinds.about: Bonds held for an average of 1 to 3 years, under a heading AMFI has since renamed.

kinds.name: Short term
kinds.about: Bonds held for an average of about 1 to 3 years.

kinds.name: Ultra short duration (earlier AMFI heading)
kinds.about: Bonds held for an average of 3 to 6 months, under a heading AMFI has since renamed.

kinds.name: Ultra short term
kinds.about: Short-dated bonds, held for months rather than years.

kinds.name: Ultra short to short term
kinds.about: Bonds between ultra short and short term.

kinds.name: ETFs, debt
kinds.about: Traded on the stock exchange; track a bond or money-market index.

kinds.name: ETFs, equity
kinds.about: Traded on the stock exchange like a share; track a share index.

kinds.name: Gold ETFs
kinds.about: Traded on the stock exchange; hold physical gold.

kinds.name: Index funds, debt
kinds.about: Track a bond index, often one that matures on a set date.

kinds.name: Index funds, equity
kinds.about: Track a share index, such as the Nifty 50, rather than choosing shares.

kinds.name: Silver ETFs
kinds.about: Traded on the stock exchange; hold physical silver.

kinds.name: Children's
kinds.about: For a child's goals: locked in for 5 years or until the child turns 18.

kinds.name: Retirement
kinds.about: For retirement: locked in for 5 years or until retirement age.
